caption: Failure taxonomy (all from real runs). 1 reconstruction failure; 2 pose-refinement divergence (handled by the A3* acceptance rule); 3 GaussianEditor appearance edit adds grain/fuzz and incoherent jitter, no deformation; 4 GE no-op caused by non-finite opacity (fixed); 5 unmasked per-view 2D baseline (fixed by masking); 6 a 2D edit that may change shape replaces observed puckering with a flat leaf.
